A medium apple typically weighs 150–200 g, and the visible apple looks medium-to-large, so I take about 180 g as the best estimate, which fits the apple's visible size.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Raw apple ≈ 52 kcal per 100 g. 180 g x 52 / 100 ≈ 94 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** One medium apple (~180 g, ~95 kcal) is plausible for a single apple on a dinner plate. The plate is otherwise empty, so no other food is added.
